request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, soft piano, cello, gentle percussion, hopeful and steady mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Some time later Joash resolved
To restore the house of the LORD
He gathered priests and Levites
To collect money from all Israel
But they did not act quickly
The chief priest asked for the tax
Laid down by Moses in the wilderness
For the tent of the testimony

[Chorus]
They made a chest at the gate
And the people dropped their silver in
All the officials rejoiced
And the chest was filled to the brim
Stonecutters and carpenters worked
To restore the original design
The workmen labored day by day
And the house of God was made whole

[Verse]
Athaliah had broken in
And used sacred things for Baal
Now the king commanded repair
And the work went forward
The Levites carried the chest
To the king’s officers each day
A large amount of money
Was collected for the temple

[Chorus]
They made a chest at the gate
And the people dropped their silver in
All the officials rejoiced
And the chest was filled to the brim
Stonecutters and carpenters worked
To restore the original design
The workmen labored day by day
And the house of God was made whole

[Bridge]
When they had finished the work
They brought the rest of the money
To make vessels for service
And articles of gold and silver
Throughout Jehoiada’s life
Burnt offerings were presented
Continually in the house of the LORD

[Outro]
The house of God was restored
And the burnt offerings continued
Faithful hands rebuilt the walls
And the sacred things returned
